concerns.text: FR-007 requires a hyperparameter sweep with `max_depth` ∈ {3, 5, 7}, but FR-003 mandates the constraint `max_depth <= 5`. The sensitivity sweep cannot be executed as specified without violating FR-003. Reconcile (e.g., widen FR-003's bound for the sensitivity analysis, or restrict the sweep to {3, 4, 5}).

FR-003 states 'If memory constraints (>7 GB) are violated without quantization, the system MUST trigger the stratified sampling strategy' — but the same FR explicitly forbids 8-bit quantization libraries ('NO GPU acceleration or 8-bit quantization'). The phrase 'without quantization' is incoherent given the prohibition; remove or reword.
SC-002 is anchored '(See US-3)', but the Full-vs-Null model comparison and permutation test are defined in US-2 / FR-002. Stale cross-reference; should point to US-2.

SC-006 (observational/associational framing) is anchored '(See US-1)', but this requirement originates from the Edge Cases section ('What happens if the dataset is observational?'), not from any US-1 acceptance scenario. Anchor is misleading.
FR-006 is anchored '(See US-1)', but collinearity detection does not appear in any US-1 acceptance scenario; it appears only in Edge Cases. Cross-reference does not resolve to matching content.
